induction n with d hd,
  { rw [Finset.range_zero, sum_empty], simp },
  { have := Finset.sum_bij (λ i : Fin d, i + 1) (Fin.dvd_iff_le.2 (Nat.succ_le_of_lt d)) (λ i, (2 * i + 1)) (λ i, (2 * i + 1)),
    rw [Finset.range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ] at this,
    rw [this],
    rw [hd],
    ring }
